property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer should revert if a callee invoked via low-level call reverts (i.e., the call must not be silently ignored); the mutant that removes the revert will allow transfer to succeed when a callee reverts.
change_summary: Remove the revert on failed external call and instead continue, so failures of called contracts no longer revert this function, changing observable state after return.
